SELECT
    ch.CHNL_K,
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON tx.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

-- Count ATM transactions per branch for the year 2025
SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON tx.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

-- Count distinct customers who were in default at the end of August 2025
WITH aug_end AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN aug_end a ON f.BUS_DT_K = a.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    d.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
    d.CCY_CD1;

-- Portfolio valuations per market for the year 2025
-- Assumes 2025 is the target year and uses the latest snapshot per market per month
-- Uses MKT_VAL1_AMT as the valuation amount (base currency assumed)
SELECT
    d.MTH_NM || ' ' || d.CAL_YR_NBR AS month_year,
    f.MKT_ID,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
GROUP BY d.MTH_NM, d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.MKT_ID
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR, f.MKT_ID;

-- Delete duplicate customer records in bank_dwh.D_CUST
-- Keep only the current version for each business identifier (BUS_ID).
-- Assumes that IS_CURR flag correctly indicates the latest version.
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
USING (
    SELECT MIN(CUST_K) AS min_cust_k, BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    GROUP BY BUS_ID
) dup
WHERE d.CUST_K <> dup.min_cust_k
  AND d.BUS_ID = dup.BUS_ID
  AND d.IS_CURR = FALSE;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT d.CTY_NM AS city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
 WHERE ddt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
   AND ddt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-03-31'
 GROUP BY d.CTY_NM
 ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

WITH june_2025_dates AS (
    SELECT dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE cal_dt BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-06-30'
), latest_june_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(dt_k) AS max_dt_k
    FROM june_2025_dates
), acct_bal AS (
    SELECT f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN latest_june_date l ON f.BUS_DT_K = l.max_dt_k
)
SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM acct_bal;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

-- Count distinct current customers with no account transaction in 2025
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM (
  SELECT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
  WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND d.IS_ACTV = TRUE
) AS cur_cust
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = cur_cust.CUST_K
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT ddt
    WHERE ddt.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
      AND ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
          COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
    f.DCLN_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
  ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

-- Total outstanding loan principal on 31‑Dec‑2025 by loan product
-- Assumes all amounts are in the same reporting currency; if multiple currencies exist, use a base currency column if available.
-- Uses the latest snapshot of disbursements and repayments up to the requested date.
WITH
  -- Disbursements up to 31‑Dec‑2025
  ds AS (
    SELECT d.LN_PRD_K,
           SUM(d.PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
  ),
  -- Repayments up to 31‑Dec‑2025
  rp AS (
    SELECT r.LN_PRD_K,
           SUM(r.PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_paid
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON r.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY r.LN_PRD_K
  )
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       COALESCE(ds.total_disbursed,0) - COALESCE(rp.total_paid,0) AS outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN ds ON p.LN_PRD_K = ds.LN_PRD_K
LEFT JOIN rp ON p.LN_PRD_K = rp.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND p.IS_ACTV = TRUE;

WITH txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
  counts AS (
    SELECT t.BR_K, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
    FROM txn_2025 t
    GROUP BY t.BR_K
  )
SELECT d.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       c.txn_cnt
FROM counts c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON c.BR_K = d.BR_K
WHERE d.IS_CURR AND d.IS_ACTV
ORDER BY c.txn_cnt DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Top 3 merchant category codes by total card authorization amount in 2025
SELECT
    d_mr.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG d_mr ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = d_mr.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_mr.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K,
         SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
), cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID,
       w.total_amount
FROM wr_2025 w
JOIN cust c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY w.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    cc.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON f.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR
),
wr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm
WHERE CUST_K IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wr);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

-- Drop the fact_complaint table
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

-- Truncate the AML alert fact table
TRUNCATE TABLE bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT;

-- Retrieve all branch names
SELECT
    BR_K,
    DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM
    bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE
    IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY
    DSPLY_NM;

-- Update customer segment to AFFLUENT for current customers residing in Cluj‑Napoca
UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

WITH dec_bal AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS dec_closing
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
    jun_bal AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS jun_closing
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 6
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM dec_bal d
JOIN jun_bal j ON d.ACCT_K = j.ACCT_K
WHERE d.dec_closing < 0.9 * j.jun_closing;

WITH cust_versions AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_segment,
        VRSN_NBR,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS prev_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
changed AS (
    SELECT BUS_ID
    FROM cust_versions
    WHERE prev_segment IS NOT NULL
      AND curr_segment <> prev_segment
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM changed;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), current_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM current_cust c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM txns t WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM txns t
  WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  AND t.QTR_NBR NOT IN (1,2,3,4)
);

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
  wires_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes_2025 d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wires_2025 w WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K);

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
 d2025 AS (
  SELECT f.LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d2024 d4
JOIN d2025 d5 ON d4.LN_ID = d5.LN_ID;

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    d.CCY_K,
    f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_K,
    STLM_AMT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_K ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_K) AS cnt
  FROM tx
)
SELECT
  cc.CCY_K,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      MAX(STLM_AMT) FILTER (WHERE rn = (cnt + 1)/2)
    ELSE
      AVG(STLM_AMT) FILTER (WHERE rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2 + 1))
  END AS median_amount
FROM ranked
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON ranked.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
GROUP BY cc.CCY_K, cnt;

WITH last_month_snap AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    MAX(f.BUS_DT_K) AS last_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_MTH_END
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  l.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM last_month_snap l
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = l.last_bus_dt_k
GROUP BY l.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY l.MTH_NBR;

WITH current_customers AS (
    SELECT c.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
      AND c.ONBRD_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND c.ONBRD_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
transactions_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC i
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON i.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM current_customers cc
JOIN transactions_2025 t ON cc.BUS_ID = (SELECT BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE CUST_K = t.CUST_K AND IS_CURR = TRUE LIMIT 1);

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT
    f.CUST_K,
    d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    d.BUS_ID,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d
    ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
    AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K, d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    segment_code,
    BUS_ID,
    total_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn
  FROM tx
)
SELECT
  segment_code,
  BUS_ID,
  total_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
  cnt AS (
    SELECT c.CCY_K, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM wr_2025 w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON w.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
    GROUP BY c.CCY_K
  ),
  total AS (
    SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM cnt
  )
SELECT c.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       ROUND(100.0 * cnt.cnt / total.total_cnt, 2) AS pct_of_2025
FROM cnt
JOIN total ON TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON cnt.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
ORDER BY pct_of_2025 DESC;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS month_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
), running AS (
  SELECT
    m.MTH_NBR,
    m.month_cnt,
    SUM(m.month_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
  FROM wr m
)
SELECT
  MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  month_cnt,
  running_total
